record.body:
## Description

Fix the failure that blocked closing verification.

## Approach

Work on branch phase/standalone-aff in ~/orchestra. Do not edit ~/affidavit or the affidavit worktree.

tests/test_affidavit_check.py::test_readme_documents_bin_affidavit_entry requires README.md to contain `aff check` or `bin/aff check`. skill-command-names pointed the acceptance-check line at `bin/orchestra check`, so the assertion fails.

Update that assertion so it requires the README to document the store command as `orchestra check` (`bin/orchestra check` or `orchestra check`). Keep the `bin/aff` assertion. Do not put `aff check` back into the README.
record.subject: fix-readme-check-phrase
